fit_reason: Although marked as a private seller, the listing text is from Steve's Auto Sales with a business address and hours, and the photos show a dealer lot with 'We Buy Cars' signage, so this is dealer stock rather than a private owner sale.
findings: Paint on the hood, doors and tailgate shows clear, glossy reflections with no visible oxidation or heavy swirling
Chrome bumpers, grille and running boards appear clean and bright
Tires and wheels look clean and dressed
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2014 Ram 1500 Big Horn. The paint and chrome already look sharp in the photos. If you ever want a mobile interior or exterior detail on lot vehicles, we come to you and would be glad to put together a quote.
